text_block_list.text:
A few days before the debut race. We ramped up
her training in high spirits for the big day, but――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Lul-la, lul-la,
lul-la-la~n♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, full sprint!
I'm baaack♡
choice_data_list: Welcome back. ...Pandora, was that your full effort just now?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Mooo-chi-mochi-mochi, full-on mochi power!
I worked super-duper hard ☆"

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaaaaarrrrrrrgh—!!!!
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*!! *cough*!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's a great time!
...Whoa, your legs are wobbling.
Are you alright? Let's take a 15-minute break—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Two minutes! I can do it in two minutes!
My debut race is coming up soon, so please let me do it!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: Pandora. Giving it your all means doing what—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Other people are other people, and we are us... right?☆
So here, your reward fruit♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

In the end, by reasoning with her, we somehow managed
to get through a proper training session. However—
choice_data_list: (Will they really be fine continuing like that...?)
(I wonder if it's okay to keep going like that...?)

text_block_list.text: I had hoped I could keep things under control. But to see her acting like this right before her debut race... her heart is even softer than a marshmallow.

Will she actually run properly in her debut race?
Harboring a faint sense of anxiety—
The day of the debut race has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...It's here, it's here, it's hereee!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Goal! Ehee~!
No matter how many times I watch it, it gives me chills~~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? It's Kuu-chan-senpai's victory scene from the NHK Mile Cup ♡
Man, she's so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, honestly,
isn't switching lanes kinda badass?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Going from the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup?
Like, who even does that normally?!
—Yes. The story goes back a little bit.
Following her magnificent victory at the Oka Sho, Rhein Kraft held an unexpected press conference.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We're changing the next race we'll take on
from the Oaks to the NHK Mile Cup!

In the Classic year of the Twinkle Series,
there are two paths: the Triple Crown route
and the Triple Tiara route.

Umamusume who choose the Triple Tiara route
typically run the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Oaks),
and the Shuka Sho in sequence.
"And yet, choosing the 'NHK Mile Cup'—which isn't part of either route—instead of the second leg, the 'Oaks,' is quite unusual."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Meaning an irregular Double Crown—
you're challenging an unprecedented glory, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As I ran along the Tiara route,
I realized that heading for the Oaks
wasn't my only option.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There's a back only I can show—
something only my legs can leave behind!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So please,
look forward to my next race, the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"With my speed, I'll claim the title of 'Fastest of the Generation'—
I will definitely seize this new brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I mean, the press conference was the absolute best, toooo!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "When you were talking about your Triple Tiara dream before, I thought, 'Whoa, her eyes are sparkling, she's so cool'... but this...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're shining so bright everyone's got their eyes on you, Senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right? ♡
I can't afford to lose either~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Win GⅠ races non-stop, stand out like crazy,
and show everyone my sheer genius, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Gotta keep sparkling brighter and brighter~!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep that spirit up and do our best today too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okay. ...Well, a debut race oughta be a piece of cake anyway☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll just dash on by
and snatch an easy win♡
choice_data_list: (Just as I feared!) ...It's not gonna be that easy!
(My bad feeling was right...) ...It's not gonna be that easy!

text_block_list.text:
First off, every rival running in a debut race
possesses enough raw talent to be scouted by a Trainer.
One must never let their guard down—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
You're totally worrying too much. It'll be fiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because I'm a genius, after all♡

...I tried talking to her for a while after that, but
it didn't seem to get through to her at all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off~☆

Clutching my head at the sight of her humming on her way to the paddock...
her debut race finally kicked off!
